row: INEOS 破二挑戰・維也納
奧地利 維也納 普拉特
2019 年 10 月 12 日，基普喬格在維也納普拉特公園的主林蔭大道以 1 小時 59 分 40.2 秒跑完馬拉松距離，第一次有人在兩小時內跑完。

title.en: INEOS 1:59: under two hours on a tree-lined avenue

tagline.zh-Hant: V 字隊形、雷射線與朝陽：拆解跑進兩小時的那天早上
tagline.en: The V formation, the laser lines and the morning sun

zh: 奧地利維也納，普拉特公園。
2019 年 10 月 12 日清晨，INEOS 1:59 挑戰。
en: The Prater, a park in Vienna, Austria.
Early on 12 October 2019: the INEOS 1:59 Challenge.

zh: 主林蔭大道又直又平，兩旁的大樹擋風；
整條路線的高低差只有 2.4 公尺。
en: The Hauptallee is straight and level, sheltered by tall trees;
the whole course rises only 2.4 metres.

zh: 以下用無名標記示意：前方五名配速員排成 V 字，
基普喬格在 V 字底端，後方還有兩人；不是轉播畫面。
en: From here on, unnamed markers: five pacemakers ahead in a V,
Eliud Kipchoge at its base and two more behind him. This is not broadcast footage.

zh: 早上 8 點 15 分出發，目標每公里約 2 分 50 秒；
前方車輛把雷射線投在路面上，標出該跑的位置。
en: They set off at 8.15 a.m., aiming for about 2:50 a kilometre;
a car ahead projected laser lines on the road to show where to run.

zh: 低低的朝陽幾乎正對著林蔭大道，
跑者迎著陽光，影子拖在身後。
en: The low morning sun shone almost straight down the avenue;
the runners ran into it, their shadows trailing behind.

zh: 每圈不到 10 公里，在兩端的圓環折返，共跑 4.4 圈；
41 名配速員分組輪替上場。
en: Each lap was just under 10 kilometres, turning at a roundabout at each end, 4.4 laps in all;
41 pacemakers took turns in groups.

zh: 氣溫從 9 度升到 12 度，沒有下雨；
選在維也納，也因為時區接近肯亞、海拔又低。
en: It was about 9 °C at the start, rising to 12 °C, and dry;
Vienna was chosen partly for its low altitude and a time zone close to Kenya's.

zh: 最後的直道上，配速員慢慢退開，
讓他一個人跑向終點。
en: On the home straight the pacemakers dropped back
and let him run to the line alone.

zh: 第一次有人在兩小時內跑完馬拉松的距離。
en: 1 hour 59 minutes 40.2 seconds:
the first time anyone had run the marathon distance in under two hours.

zh: 因為配速員輪替、由單車遞水，又不是公開比賽，
這個成績不算世界紀錄；兩年前他在蒙札還差 25 秒。
en: With rotating pacemakers, drinks from a bicycle and no open race,
it was not a record; two years earlier, at Monza, he had fallen 25 seconds short.

zh: 他說：「沒有人是有極限的。」
2026 年倫敦馬拉松，沙威跑出 1 小時 59 分 30 秒，
首次在正式比賽中跑進兩小時。
en: "No human is limited," he said.
At the 2026 London Marathon, Sabastian Sawe ran 1:59:30:
the first sub-two-hour marathon in a race.

zh: 本片為示意畫面：跑者以無名標記呈現，隊形依報導示意，
間距與終點位置為示意，不是轉播畫面。
en: Illustration: the runners are unnamed markers and the formation is shown as reported;
its spacing and the finish position are illustrative. This is not broadcast footage.
